simple.meaning: פַּר (par) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a bullock (apparently as breaking forth in wild strength, or perhaps as dividing the hoof).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 133 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Judges, and 2 more, beginning at Genesis 32:16. Its contexts include family line, offering, sacrifice, priesthood, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פַּר (H6499).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: פַּר (par) / H6499 is traced through Genesis 32:16, Exodus 24:5, Exodus 29:1, Exodus 29:3 as a generated source-based concept entry.
